hyperedges.label: Party preparation workflow (package, audio setup, score tuning)
Two editions from one codebase (party + studio)

nodes.label: electron-builder.yml (party packaging)
nodes.rationale: appId com.gritometro.app, output dist, nsis + portable x64.

nodes.label: electron-builder.studio.yml (Gritometro Studio packaging)
nodes.rationale: appId com.gritometro.studio, output dist-studio, nsis + portable x64.

nodes.label: Age bonus multiplier
nodes.rationale: Defaults x1.3 up to 5 years, x1.15 up to 8 so little kids can win.

nodes.label: Suggested challenge order (Ranking, Torneo, Tanque, Silencio)
nodes.norm_label: suggested challenge order (ranking, torneo, tanque, silencio)
nodes.rationale: Warm up with Ranking, escalate with Tournament and team Tank, calm down with the silence challenge.

nodes.label: dB SPL calibration offset
nodes.rationale: Approximate; the score does not depend on it.

nodes.label: USB console / multichannel interface
nodes.rationale: Chromium may report only 2 channels due to the Windows WDM driver limitation.

nodes.label: VoiceMeeter Banana routing
nodes.rationale: Mic on Hardware Input 1 to bus B1, select VoiceMeeter VAIO output, 48 kHz, no heavy compressor (it would equalize all kids).

nodes.label: Portable Windows .exe
nodes.rationale: No install needed; ideal to carry on USB to the party.

nodes.label: Mic comparison flow (takes, A/B sync, blind test)
nodes.norm_label: mic comparison flow (takes, a/b sync, blind test)
nodes.rationale: Blind test with matchLoudness is the subjective reference; take audio lives only in memory, metrics are saved.

nodes.label: Separate studio release (studio-vX.Y.Z, --latest=false)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the birthday release marked Latest.

nodes.label: Virtual mixer console (strips, A/B buses, scenes)
nodes.norm_label: virtual mixer console (strips, a/b buses, scenes)

nodes.label: Persistence pipeline (store -> storage -> IPC -> data/<key>.json)
nodes.rationale: New settings fields need defaults because the store merges defaults on load; saves debounced per key and serialized in main.

nodes.label: Studio edition (__EDITION__='studio', GRIT_EDITION)
nodes.rationale: Same code, opens straight into StudioShell standalone behind an access code, own appId and data folder.

nodes.label: Renderer Content-Security-Policy
nodes.rationale: script-src 'self' only (no data: scripts), media-src allows mediastream:, worker-src self/blob.

nodes.label: Scream score formula (0.7 sustained peak + 0.3 average)
nodes.norm_label: scream score formula (0.7 sustained peak + 0.3 average)
nodes.rationale: Score = (0.7*sustainedPeak + 0.3*windowAverage)/rangeDb*100*ageMultiplier, clipped 0-100, 1 decimal. Changing the scale makes saved records incomparable.

nodes.label: sustainedPeak anti-cheat (minBurstMs)
nodes.rationale: Best average over any minBurstMs window so short hits, claps or blowing on the mic do not count.

nodes.label: Simple vs advanced audio mode (effectiveProfile)
nodes.rationale: Simple mode exposes only device + noise calibration and uses safe values for everything else via effectiveProfile.

nodes.label: Hidden studio activation (Ctrl+Shift+S / 5 clicks)
nodes.rationale: Intentionally hidden so the party UI never shows it; state saved in settings.appMode.

nodes.label: PCM tap AudioWorklet (pcmTap.worklet.js)
nodes.rationale: Imported with ?url&no-inline because the CSP blocks data: URLs; ScriptProcessorNode only as fallback; tapped only while someone listens.

nodes.label: Studio access code (SHA-256 only, unlock.ts)
nodes.rationale: Repo is public, so only the hash is stored; tests read the clear code from STUDIO_CODE env var.

nodes.label: GameMode contract (pure init/nextTurn/applyResult/standings)
nodes.rationale: Modes are pure (state in, new state out, never mutate), with no React or audio, so they are unit testable.

nodes.label: Offline fonts only (@fontsource)
nodes.rationale: The party venue may have no internet.

nodes.label: Theme contract (tokens, texts, components, soundStyle)
nodes.rationale: Themes only supply appearance; hex colors for the color editor; contrast >= 4.5:1.

nodes.label: Mic owned only by audioEngine singleton
nodes.norm_label: mic owned only by audioengine singleton
nodes.rationale: Screens subscribe via hooks or onPcm; newer start/stop always wins over a slower one.

nodes.label: core/ must stay framework-free
nodes.rationale: So pure logic can be unit tested in Node with Vitest.

nodes.label: Neutral professional app icon
nodes.rationale: The same exe serves the studio mode, so the icon must not be kid-themed.
